story_description: Implement the Plugins Selection View that displays available plugins from the remote registry grouped by CLI type, allowing users to browse, search, filter, and select plugins for installation during onboarding or from settings.
task_description: Create the SwiftUI view for browsing and selecting plugins from the registry, featuring grouped sections by CLI, search functionality, filter controls, plugin cards with metadata display, and multi-selection with installation tracking.
atom_description: Implement PluginsSelectionView.swift as a SwiftUI view that renders plugins from RegistryManager grouped by their forCli property (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex CLI sections). The view includes a search bar for filtering by name/description, category filter chips, LazyVGrid layout for plugin cards, selection state management via Binding to Set of PluginItem, and visual feedback for installed vs available plugins. Each plugin card displays name, description, version, author, download count, and an install/selected toggle button.
problem_statement: Users need a visual interface to discover and select plugins from the remote extension registry during onboarding. Without a dedicated plugins view grouped by CLI, users cannot easily find plugins compatible with their installed CLI tools. The view must handle potentially hundreds of plugins efficiently with search, filtering, and lazy loading.

PluginItem.forCli contains CLI identifiers matching CLIType.rawValue
OnboardingState.installedCLIs provides Set of CLIType for filtering
PluginItem.metadata.tags provides category strings for filter chips
PluginsSelectionView receives selectedPlugins binding from parent
View will be used both in onboarding flow and settings panel
Maximum plugin count is under 500 items per CLI type
Plugin cards use consistent 280x180pt card size
constraints: Must use SwiftUI only without UIKit bridging
Must support macOS 14.0 minimum deployment target
LazyVGrid must be used for performance with large plugin counts
View must not block main thread during filtering operations
Must follow existing Blaze design system colors and typography
Card grid must be responsive to window width changes
Search debouncing must prevent excessive filtering calls
Must handle RTL languages for international plugin names
functional_requirements: FR-01: Display plugins grouped by CLI type with collapsible section headers showing CLI name and plugin count
FR-02: Show only CLI sections for which user has installed CLIs per OnboardingState.installedCLIs
FR-03: Render search bar at top that filters plugins by name and description case-insensitively
FR-04: Display horizontal scrolling filter chips for unique tags across all visible plugins
FR-05: Render plugin cards in LazyVGrid with adaptive columns based on container width
FR-06: Each plugin card must display name, description (truncated to 2 lines), version badge, author name, and download count
FR-07: Plugin card must show installation status via icon or badge (installed, selected, available)
FR-08: Tapping plugin card toggles selection state in bound Set of PluginItem
FR-09: Selected plugins display checkmark overlay and highlighted border
FR-10: Show empty state with illustration when no plugins match current filters
FR-11: Show loading skeleton cards while registry data is being fetched
FR-12: Show error state with message and retry button when registry fetch fails
nonfunctional_requirements: NFR-01: Initial render of 100 plugin cards must complete within 200ms on M1 Mac
NFR-02: Search filtering of 500 plugins must complete within 50ms
NFR-03: Scroll performance must maintain 60fps with 200 visible cards
NFR-04: Memory usage must not exceed 50MB with 500 plugins loaded
NFR-05: View must support VoiceOver accessibility with proper labels
implementation_steps: Create Blaze/Sources/Onboarding/PluginsSelectionView.swift with file header and imports
Define PluginsSelectionView struct conforming to View with @Binding selectedPlugins: Set<PluginItem>
Add @EnvironmentObject registryManager: RegistryManager for accessing plugin data
Add @EnvironmentObject onboardingState: OnboardingState for accessing installedCLIs
Add @State searchText: String for search bar binding
Add @State selectedTags: Set<String> for filter chip selection
Add computed property filteredPlugins that applies search and tag filters to registryManager.plugins
Add computed property groupedPlugins that groups filteredPlugins by forCli into Dictionary
Add computed property uniqueTags that extracts all tags from visible plugins for filter chips
Implement body with VStack containing SearchBar, FilterChipsView, and ScrollView with grouped sections
Create SearchBar view component with TextField and clear button
Create FilterChipsView with horizontal ScrollView of toggle-able tag chips
Create CLISectionView that renders section header and LazyVGrid of PluginCardView
Create PluginCardView displaying card with name, description, version, author, download count, status
Add selection toggle logic in PluginCardView.onTapGesture modifying selectedPlugins binding
Create EmptyStateView for no results with illustration and message
Create LoadingStateView with skeleton card placeholders using redacted modifier
Create ErrorStateView with error message and retry button calling registryManager.refresh()
Add debounced search using Combine publisher to prevent excessive filtering
Add accessibility labels to all interactive elements
Write unit tests for filtering logic in Tests/PluginsSelectionViewModelTests.swift
Write UI tests for selection behavior in UITests/PluginsSelectionViewUITests.swift
data_model_changes: No new data models - view consumes existing PluginItem from RegistryModels.swift
View state uses @State and @Binding without persistent storage
Filter state is ephemeral and not persisted between sessions

edge_cases: User has no CLIs installed - show message prompting CLI installation first
Registry returns empty plugins array - show empty state not error state
Plugin has empty forCli array - do not display in any section
Plugin has nil or empty description - show placeholder description text
Plugin name contains special characters or emoji - render correctly
User rapidly toggles selection - debounce state updates
Network disconnects during scroll - cached data remains visible
User clears all filters - return to full plugin list
Plugin appears in multiple CLI groups - show in all applicable sections
Search text matches only description not name - still show in results
failure_modes: RegistryManager.plugins is nil - treat as loading state not error
Registry fetch throws error - display error state with retry
Plugin card image URL fails to load - show placeholder image
Filter produces zero results - show empty state not error
Selection binding update fails - log error but preserve UI state
Memory pressure during large grid render - LazyVGrid handles via recycling
rollback_plan: Delete PluginsSelectionView.swift and PluginCardView.swift files. Update any parent views that reference PluginsSelectionView to use placeholder EmptyView. No database changes to revert. User selection state in OnboardingState.selectedPlugins remains empty.

notes: This atom implements the R007-PLUGINSUI specification from the feature doc. The view is similar to R006-SKILLSUI but uses CLI-grouped sections instead of a flat grid. The PluginCardView component should be reusable for other contexts like settings plugin management.

Run swift test --filter PluginsSelectionViewModelTests and verify all 9 unit tests pass
Run UI tests with xcodebuild test and verify PluginsSelectionViewUITests all pass

risks: LazyVGrid performance may degrade with very large plugin counts over 500
Search debouncing timing may feel sluggish to users
CLI grouping logic may not handle plugins supporting multiple CLIs correctly
Filter chip horizontal scroll may clip on narrow windows
PluginCardView layout may break with very long plugin names
mitigations: Implement virtualization hints for LazyVGrid if performance issues observed
Tune debounce delay to 150ms and test user perception
Ensure plugins appear in all applicable CLI sections not just first match
Add horizontal scroll indicator and test on minimum supported window width
Truncate long names with ellipsis and show full name in tooltip
risk_register.blast_radius: Medium - affects onboarding flow and settings plugin view. Does not affect core session or chat functionality. Regression would block plugin selection but not app launch.
risk_register.fallback_plan: If performance is unacceptable, replace LazyVGrid with List view using Section headers. If grouping logic proves complex, fall back to flat grid like SkillsSelectionView. Can ship MVP without tag filtering if needed.
